question: A community garden tracked the total number of pumpkins growing in its main patch throughout the season, starting with 237 pumpkins in early summer. By midsummer, a second patch's crop added 61 more pumpkins to the tracked total. By late summer, ideal weather multiplied the tracked pumpkin count by 7. By early fall, a final growth spurt added 29 more pumpkins. By mid-fall, a blight destroyed 236 pumpkins from the tracked patch. A separate community garden across town, unrelated to this patch, grew 500 pumpkins. By late fall, a final harvest added 22 more pumpkins to the tracked total. How many pumpkins did the tracked patch show by late fall?

A city tracked the total number of parking permits issued downtown, starting with 156 permits already issued this year. A spring renewal wave added 45 more permits. A summer wave added 9 more. A batch of expired permits then removed 74 from the tracked total. A fall renewal wave added 74 more permits back. The permits were then split evenly among 6 parking zones, and only Zone 1's count was tracked from then on — the city noted this in its report as converting citywide permits into a per-zone count, a simple unit change. Finally, a zone expansion multiplied the tracked zone's count by 5. How many permits did Zone 1's tracked count show after the expansion?

A comic shop had 40 back-issue comics in a discount bin. A donation added 52 more comics. A collector bought 51 of them in one visit. A restock added 74 more comics. A convention weekend then tripled the tracked bin's comic count. A second surge of interest tripled it again. A separate long-box in the back room, unrelated to this bin, held 200 comics. How many comics were in the discount bin after the second surge?

A brewery tracked the total gallons of beer in Tank 9 throughout the day, starting with 169 gallons at dawn. During the morning, 58 gallons were drawn off for bottling. By midday, the remaining beer was split evenly into 3 identical tanks, and only the first tank's volume was tracked from then on. In the afternoon, 28 gallons were used for quality testing. By evening, 1 more gallon was lost to a small leak. A separate tank, Tank 10, unrelated to this one, held 400 gallons. By night, a fresh addition added 35 more gallons to the tracked tank. How many gallons were in the tracked tank by night?

A beekeeper tracked the total pounds of honey in the extraction barrel throughout harvest day, starting with 28 pounds at dawn. By mid-morning, a second hive's harvest doubled the tracked barrel weight. By midday, a third hive's harvest multiplied the tracked weight by 6. By afternoon, a small top-off added 9 more pounds. By evening, a fourth hive's harvest multiplied the tracked weight by 6 again. By night, a final top-off added 71 more pounds. How many pounds of honey were in the tracked barrel by night?

Runner Kofi tracked the total miles he'd logged this training block, starting with 86 miles. His training partner, Odessa, had logged a mere dozen miles by comparison, but only Kofi's mileage is tracked here. A big week added 71 more miles. A second big week added 73 more miles. A taper-and-double push doubled his tracked total. Finally, an injury forced him to scratch 398 miles of planned training from the tracked total. How many miles did Kofi's tracked total show after the setback?

A vineyard tracked the total gallons of wine in its aging barrel, starting with 124 gallons. A bottling run removed 71 gallons. A fresh blend then multiplied the tracked barrel's volume by 4. A tasting event used up 35 more gallons. Converting the tracked volume into a bottle-count estimate for the export order — a simple unit change — the vintner multiplied the tracked number by 9. A separate barrel, unrelated to this one, held 300 gallons. Finally, a doubled export order multiplied the tracked bottle count by 6. How many bottles did the tracked total represent?

Farmer Basile tracked the total pounds of grapes picked in the north vineyard, starting with 177 pounds. His neighbor, farmer Okoro, was picking in a separate vineyard that had already gathered a mere dozen pounds, but only Basile's north vineyard is tracked here. A morning pick added 21 more pounds. An afternoon pick added 71 more pounds. A shipment out then removed 156 pounds from the tracked total. Converting the remaining grapes into a case-count estimate for the winery — a simple unit change — Basile doubled the tracked number to represent the case count. How many cases did the tracked total represent?

A print shop tracked the total flyers on the press run, starting with 107 flyers. A test batch removed 35 flyers for quality checks. A dozen new ink cartridges were installed that morning, though that number has nothing to do with the flyer count. A full production run then multiplied the tracked flyer count by 6. A big client order removed 282 flyers from the tracked total. A second client added 78 more flyers back into the tracked run. A third client added 46 more. Finally, a damaged batch removed 197 flyers from the tracked total. A separate press run, unrelated to this one, produced 500 flyers. How many flyers were in the tracked run at the end?

A charity thrift store tracked the total number of donated books on its shelf, starting with 143 books. A huge donation multiplied the tracked shelf count by 6. A dozen customers browsed that morning, though that number has nothing to do with the book count. A big book club purchase then removed 666 books from the tracked shelf. A small donation added 28 more books. A second donation added 68 more. A final donation added 55 more books. How many books were on the tracked shelf by the end of the day?

Cyclist Farah tracked the total miles she'd ridden this training camp, starting with 69 miles logged on day one. Her teammate, cyclist Boyer, had logged a separate total of 900 miles that season, but only Farah's camp mileage is tracked here. Day two added 80 more miles. Day three added 54 more miles. Day four added 51 more miles. Finally, a hill-repeat day multiplied her tracked mileage by 8 to account for the elevation-adjusted distance. How many elevation-adjusted miles did Farah's tracked total show?

A city tracked the total number of trees planted in the riverside park throughout the year, starting with 166 trees in early spring. By late spring, a volunteer event added 56 more trees. By summer, a grant-funded expansion multiplied the tracked tree count by 6. By fall, a construction project required removing 391 trees from the tracked park. By winter, a final planting added 80 more trees. How many trees did the riverside park's tracked count show by winter?

Coach Ibarra tracked the total points scored by her basketball team throughout the tournament, starting with 150 points from the opening game. Her assistant, Coach Nwosu, tracked the junior team's points separately, totaling 900, but only Ibarra's team is tracked here. By the second game, 66 more points were added. By the third game, 44 more points were added. By the fourth game, 74 more points were added. By the championship game, a scoring bonus for the finals multiplied the tracked total by 9. How many points did Ibarra's tracked total show after the championship game?

In the morning, Maya had 150 stickers in her collection. By midday she had traded away 30 of them to a friend for a poster. In the afternoon, a sticker vending machine replaced every sticker she had left with 5 shiny new ones. That evening, her sticker count doubled again when her cousin mailed her a matching set. Right after that, she found 3 more stickers tucked inside an old notebook, and later her aunt mailed her a big envelope holding 66 more, all within a stretch of time that felt like a full 60 minutes. How many stickers did Maya have after her aunt's envelope arrived?

Jake's lemonade stand cash box held $148 at the start of the day. A neighboring stand collected a stray $20 bill that a customer meant for napkins, so that money never touched Jake's box. During the morning rush the box grew by $46, then by another $26 from the after-school crowd, and by $34 more from a big group order. Before closing, a good-sales-day bonus turned every dollar in the box into 4 dollars. Right after that, a local business match program turned every dollar into 8 dollars. How much money was in Jake's cash box after the business match program finished?

Priya kept a single jar of glass marbles that held 238 marbles one Saturday morning. During a game with friends she won 33 more marbles, then found 21 additional ones under the porch. At lunch, her little brother borrowed a dozen cookies from the pantry for a snack, which had nothing to do with the marbles, but Priya still had to pay back 253 marbles she owed her cousin from an old bet. That afternoon, a marble-trading event that took two hours, or 120 minutes, to organize turned every marble she had into 6 new ones, and later a bonus round turned each of those into 9 more. Finally, she gave 128 marbles to her cousin as a thank-you gift. How many marbles did Priya have in her jar after giving the thank-you gift?

Liam started a new video game level with 39 points already banked from a bonus. A power-up turned every point he had into 9 points. Then a combo turned each of those into 7 more points. He also found a hidden dozen coins in a secret room, which didn't affect his score at all. Landing a rare achievement added 72 points to his total, but a trap immediately after cost him 1132 points. A final treasure chest then turned every remaining point into 5 points. What was Liam's point total after opening the treasure chest?

Grandma Rosa's classroom library began the semester with 133 books on its shelves. She donated 43 books to a sister school in need. A publisher then sent 53 brand-new books as a grant reward. When the reading club reorganized, every book on the shelf was matched with 6 duplicate copies for a book fair display, set up with help from a dozen or so volunteers. The fair brought in 24 more donated books afterward. At the end of the semester, 765 books were shipped off to a regional donation center. How many books remained on Rosa's classroom shelves after the shipment?

Ethan's piggy bank held $68 saved from odd jobs around the house. He earned $15 more for mowing a neighbor's lawn. He then spent $34 on a new bike helmet. A birthday gift afterward turned every dollar in the piggy bank into 7 dollars. Right after that, Ethan paid $326 toward a new bicycle. How much money was left in Ethan's piggy bank after buying the bicycle?

In the morning, Diego had $218 saved in his savings account. By midday he had earned $49 more from a weekend job. That afternoon, a bank promotion doubled the money in his account. In the evening, a birthday check for $69 arrived and was added to his balance. Right before the bank closed for the night, a final loyalty bonus turned every dollar in his account into 6 dollars. How much money was in Diego's savings account after the loyalty bonus was applied?

Ava had 13 party favors left after her birthday celebration, while her friend Ben had 47 party favors of his own that day. Ava's grandmother then turned every favor she had into 5 new party favors as a surprise. Ava gave 3 favors to her teacher as a thank-you gift. Later, her aunt gave her 18 more favors for a class project. Finally, Ava used 49 favors to decorate the school bulletin board. How many party favors did Ava have left after decorating the bulletin board?

In the morning, Marcus had 88 baseball cards in his binder, while his friend Tony had 102 cards in his own collection. By midday, Marcus traded away 41 cards at a card show. That afternoon, a rare booster pack turned every card he had left into 5 new cards. In the evening, he found 4 more cards under his bed. Right before bedtime, he mailed 170 cards to his cousin as a gift. How many baseball cards did Marcus have left after mailing the gift to his cousin?

In the morning, a courier named Wes had 119 packages loaded in his van. By midday he picked up 48 more packages from the depot. That afternoon he delivered 119 packages to a large office building. In the evening he picked up 63 more packages for a late round. Right before his shift ended, he handed off 29 packages to another driver during a stop that lasted half an hour, or 30 minutes. How many packages did Wes have in his van after handing off packages to the other driver?

Camille's charity jar held $92 after the weekend bake sale. She split the money evenly into 4 identical envelopes for different charities and kept only one envelope for the local shelter. She then spent $1 on a stamp to mail a thank-you note. A generous donor added $14 more to the shelter's envelope. A matching sponsor then turned every dollar in the envelope into 9 dollars, and a final grant turned each of those into 8 dollars, a process the shelter director said took about 90 minutes, or an hour and a half, from start to finish. How much money was in Camille's envelope after the final grant was applied?

In the morning, a food truck had 56 tacos prepped for the day. Right after opening, 1 taco was dropped and had to be thrown out. By midday, the cooks prepped 39 more tacos for the lunch rush. In the afternoon, they prepped 30 additional tacos ahead of a big event. That evening, 75 tacos were sold to a catering client. Right before closing, a bulk order from a food blogger turned every remaining taco into 8 tacos for a viral recipe video, a shoot the crew joked took '60 minutes, or a whole hour' to set up. How many tacos did the food truck have after the bulk order for the blogger?
